questions.title: Selection Bias
questions.text: Selection bias occurs when the data sample perfectly creates a representative model of the entire population.
questions.explanation: Selection bias happens when the sample CANNOT represent the entire population (e.g., excluding elderly people by only surveying digital users).

questions.title: Algorithmic Bias
questions.text: Algorithmic bias only occurs when the developers explicitly program prejudice into the system.
questions.explanation: Algorithmic bias often happen by the insatisfaction of historical data and limited judgement elements.

questions.title: Confirmation Bias
questions.text: Confirmation bias is the tendency to search for and interpret information in a way that confirms one's preexisting beliefs.
questions.explanation: Confirmation bias is people tend to accept information that supports their views and reject contradictions.
